title: ResDine
subtitle: Enterprise B2B Multi-Tenant Restaurant SaaS Platform
description: A scalable, multi-tenant B2B restaurant SaaS platform hosting thousands of independent restaurant businesses on a single infrastructure. Features tenant-isolated POS, kitchen display system (KDS), dynamic subscription plans, customer ordering marketplace, and automated accounting.
problemStatement: Standard restaurant ERPs are monolithic single-tenant systems that cannot scale to support multi-tenant restaurant chains or SaaS operations without massive database redundancy and data leakage risks.
solution: Architected a Service-Oriented multi-tenant SaaS with Laravel 12 and Inertia.js (Vue 3). Implemented automatic query-level data isolation via HasTenant global scopes across 56+ tables, dynamic subscription modules, zero-storage client QR-code table ordering, and real-time WebSocket syncing with Laravel Reverb.
features: Multi-Tenant Isolation with HasTenant Global Scopes across 56+ tables
DevAdmin SaaS Control Center with dynamic subscription tiers and module access
Public FoodPanda-Style Customer Marketplace with Bento Grid tenant directory
Zero-Storage Client-Side QR Codes for direct digital menu table ordering
Real-time Kitchen Display System (KDS) & line prep views via WebSockets
Recipe-level ingredient inventory deduction and automated stock ledgers
Integrated Double-Entry Accounting (COA, Trial Balance, P&L) and HRM/Payroll
challenges: Enforcing ironclad data isolation across 56+ database tables using global Eloquent traits and scopes without performance bottlenecks.
Invalidating cached Redis sessions automatically across all tenant users when subscription tiers are modified.
Migrating real-time order tracking to a push-based WebSocket architecture with Laravel Reverb.
architecture: Service-Oriented multi-tenant architecture with Inertia.js SPA hydration, Redis cache-busting, Laravel Reverb WebSockets for real-time dispatch, and distributed MySQL/TiDB.
databaseDesign: Multi-tenant relational schema partitioned by tenant_id with global query enforcement, subscription plan pivot relations, and double-entry transaction ledgers.
deployment: Deployed on Linux VPS / Render using Nginx, TiDB / MySQL, Redis, and Laravel Horizon for queue and WebSocket workers.

title: Career OS
subtitle: AI-Powered Career Intelligence, ATS & Job Tracker
description: An end-to-end AI career intelligence and job search operating system. Combines multi-source job circular aggregation, asynchronous AI resume-to-job matching, intelligent ATS CV builder, mock interview simulations, application Kanban tracking, and networking CRM.
problemStatement: Job hunters juggle fragmented job boards, generic keyword ATS rejections, tedious manual resume formatting, and no centralized way to practice role-specific technical interviews.
solution: Built a production-grade full-stack platform featuring a Laravel 12 API backend with queue workers/Supervisor, PostgreSQL, React 19 SPA, and OpenAI API. Integrated live automated circular scraping, interactive ATS CV builder, AI mock test evaluations, Kanban application tracker, and multi-gateway billing (Stripe & SSLCommerz).
features: Asynchronous AI Resume Parsing & Deep Job Match Score Evaluation
Intelligent ATS CV Builder with dynamic export and AI tailoring
Multi-Source Job Circulars Aggregation with automated sync and prune schedulers
Interactive Job Application Kanban Tracking & Networking CRM
AI Mock Test Engine with dynamic question generation and instant evaluation
AI Career Tools: Cover Letter Generator, Interview Prep, Salary Negotiation Coach, and 24/7 AI Coach
Public Shareable Portfolio View & Profile Customization
Enterprise Auth with 6-digit email OTP verification & Google OAuth
challenges: Handling long-running LLM completions asynchronously via queues and Supervisor workers without causing HTTP timeouts.
Designing a normalized schema for multi-source job circular scraping while maintaining lightning-fast candidate search.
Real-time state synchronization between React client (Zustand) and backend queue job progress.
architecture: Decoupled headless architecture: Laravel REST API with queue workers, Redis/Supervisor, and PostgreSQL, powering a React 19 SPA with Zustand state management and a Chrome Extension handshake.
databaseDesign: PostgreSQL relational schema supporting user portfolios, multi-tenant billing history, circular scraping catalogs, and structured resume parsing vectors.
deployment: Dockerized deployment with Supervisor process managers for Laravel scheduler and background queue workers.

title: Travel Suit
subtitle: Full-Stack Hotel & Resort Booking System
description: A full-stack hotel and resort booking platform featuring real-time room availability, add-on hospitality service reservations, Pusher WebSocket live chat between guests and managers, and a multi-tiered premium customer loyalty discount system.
problemStatement: Hospitality businesses often face disconnected booking pipelines, lack direct real-time communication between guests and front-desk managers, and miss automated loyalty reward mechanisms.
solution: Engineered a full-featured Laravel web platform with Blade and Bootstrap 5, complete with role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Customer), live messaging via Pusher WebSockets, dynamic date-range availability checks, and automatic Silver/Gold loyalty discounts.
features: Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Hotel Manager, Customer)
Real-time Room Availability & Date-range Reservation Engine
Add-on Hospitality Services Booking (Spa, Dining, Gym, Room Service)
Real-time Customer-to-Manager Live Chat via Pusher WebSockets
Tiered Premium Loyalty Subscriptions (Silver 5%, Gold 10% auto-discounts)
Manager Operations Panel for Room CRUD, Service Pricing, and Booking Approval
challenges: Preventing double-booking and date overlaps through database-level transaction locking during checkout.
Building persistent real-time chat between guests and staff using Pusher WebSocket channels with unread status tracking.
architecture: Modular MVC architecture in Laravel 12 with role-based middleware guards, WebSocket event broadcasting via Pusher, and clean Blade templating.
databaseDesign: Relational MySQL schema modeling rooms, amenities JSON, bookings, pivot service relationships, message history, and premium membership tiers.
deployment: Deployable on standard LAMP/LEMP stacks with PHP 8.2+, MySQL, and Pusher Channels.

title: Cartessa
subtitle: Multi-Tenant E-Commerce SaaS Platform
description: A modern, multi-tenant headless e-commerce SaaS platform allowing independent merchants to launch and manage branded online storefronts with infinite dynamic product variants, automated order fulfillment, glassmorphic UI, and platform administration.
problemStatement: Traditional e-commerce platforms struggle with multi-tenant data isolation, lack support for arbitrary dynamic product variant matrices without rigid schema changes, and couple frontends tightly to legacy CMS engines.
solution: Designed a strictly decoupled, API-driven architecture pairing a Laravel 11 Sanctum REST API with a React 18 & Framer Motion SPA. Features store_id scoped multi-tenancy, dynamic variant matrix resolution, slug-based tenant store routing, and auto-printable sales reporting.
features: Multi-Tenant Isolation with store_id scoping across products, categories, and orders
Platform Superadmin Control Center for tenant onboarding and subscription management
Merchant Dashboard with nested categories, dynamic variant matrix, and order fulfillment
Sales Analytics & Auto-Print PDF reports for streamlined store accounting
Headless Glassmorphic Customer Storefront with Framer Motion animations
Dynamic Slug-based Tenant Routing and Client-Side Cart Management
challenges: Designing a normalized database schema separating products, product_variants, and variant_attributes to support arbitrary variant permutations (Size, Color, Material).
Ensuring financial data integrity by locking historical unit prices into order items upon checkout.
Building a decoupled SPA storefront that resolves tenant identity dynamically from URL path slugs without leaking cross-tenant data.
architecture: Headless decoupled architecture: Laravel 11 RESTful API backend secured by Sanctum, serving a high-performance React 18 (Vite) Single Page Application.
databaseDesign: Normalized multi-tenant relational database with strict store_id scoping, dynamic variant attributes, historical pricing snapshots, and subscription tiers.
deployment: Production-ready REST API and Vite build pipeline with MySQL database.

title: DFMS
subtitle: Digital File Management System
description: A robust document and file management solution designed for corporate clients to digitize, organize, and securely share their internal files and records.
problemStatement: The client struggled with decentralized physical records and an unstructured digital file sharing process, causing delays in audits and day-to-day operations.
solution: Built a secure, role-based document management platform with advanced search capabilities, version control, and comprehensive audit logs.
features: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
File Versioning
Activity Logging
Secure File Storage
challenges: Implementing efficient and secure handling of large file uploads.
Designing an intuitive folder and permission inheritance system.

title: PrinterMis
subtitle: Printing & Cylinder Management SaaS
description: A comprehensive printing management SaaS acting as a mediator for printing companies. It streamlines the process of client orders for printing and cylinders for major brands like Mum drinks and Pran chanachur.
problemStatement: Managing complex printing orders, cylinder specifications, and mediating between clients and printing companies manually was highly error-prone and inefficient.
solution: Built a centralized SaaS platform to manage the end-to-end lifecycle of printing and cylinder orders, serving as a seamless mediator between enterprise clients and printing companies.
features: Client Order Management
Cylinder Specification Tracking
Mediator Dashboard
Real-time Order Status
achievements: Streamlined order processing for major national brands
challenges: Architecting a scalable multi-tenant SaaS architecture for different printing companies.

title: RecipeSys
subtitle: Food Manufacturing Recipe Manager
description: An internal company tool built to standardize and scale food manufacturing processes by meticulously managing ingredient ratios, batch sizing, and nutritional calculations.
problemStatement: Inconsistent batch outputs due to manual recipe scaling and lack of centralized ingredient data.
solution: Engineered a centralized system that dynamically recalculates ingredient quantities and nutritional info based on target batch sizes.
features: Dynamic Batch Scaling
Nutritional Value Calculation
Ingredient Cost Analysis
challenges: Handling complex unit conversions across various measurement systems.
